articles.summary: So, when can an Escrow be used to solve a problem and get a deal closed? An “after closing” Escrow where the transaction closes but the seller places funds in Escrow to be disbursed as agreed in an Escrow Agreement can be a life saver on deals where the parties want or need to close but there are items still to be done.
